name: ordinal_words
description: Produce the English ordinal word for a numbered position; control produces the cardinal word for the same position.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
ordinals='first second third fourth fifth sixth seventh eighth ninth tenth'.split()
cardinals='one two three four five six seven eight nine ten'.split()
items=[];control=[]
contexts=['runner','student','car','book','entry','ticket','song','team','box','horse']
for i in range(100):
 n=i%10+1; obj=random.choice(contexts)
 prefix=f'The {obj} is at position {n} in the list. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'Write that position as an English ordinal word. Answer:', 'answer':' '+ordinals[n-1]})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'Write that number as an English cardinal word. Answer:', 'answer':' '+cardinals[n-1]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
